verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee returns scraped data in open, non-proprietary formats (raw HTML, JSON via extract_rules/ai_query, and markdown via return_page_markdown), so output data is never locked into a proprietary format. However, there is no evidence of an account-level data export (e.g., stored schedules, usage history, session data) or an explicit 'export and leave' data-portability feature. missing for 10: account/config data export tooling, explicit data-portability/GDPR export statement, independent confirmation of format openness.
